desc: 云感绗缝开场，手压回弹与气流机制层层递进，双栏对照与机洗护理收口信任
name: 云柔夹棉床垫加厚保护垫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里用饱满绗缝体块与安静卧室底色抢第一眼点击，不依赖任何图内文字。
一秒把云感柔软与回弹不塌的核心利益讲清，用一只手的压痕代替文字形容。
shots.textZone: 左上空白标题带一行「{selling_point_1}」，左下两枚空白胶囊标签位「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用箭头机制解释表层如何透气不闷，替代任何体感与温控数字主张。
shots.textZone: 左上一行短标题位「{selling_point_3}」，左下两枚空白胶囊标签位，右下一枚空白方框印章位

shots.intent: 让买家把自己代入侧卧姿态，用轮廓虚线与节点自证贴合与压力分散。
shots.textZone: 上方四枚空白胶囊标签位「{callout_3}」等四条短标签位，不渲染任何具体主张

shots.intent: 用缝线与松紧围边的微距证明做工与包裹力，替掉一切尺寸与深度数值。
用同机位双栏与勾叉行位承接差异主张，把两侧具体说辞全部留空由后台填入。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行主标题位「{selling_point_2}」，两栏各五行空白标签条，不出现任何具体字样

shots.intent: 用洗衣房实拍感把打理成本降到一个动作，收口消除最后的耐用与清洁顾虑。
shots.textZone: 底部两枚空白胶囊标签位「{callout_4}」等两条短标签位，护理卡三行空参数线

style.backgroundSystem: seamless studio fields alternating clean white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F1E8 and pale mint #DCE9D2, plus calm bedroom and laundry frames on warm plaster and oat cabinet walls with pale oak floors

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent calm premium home-textile ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F1E8, bamboo green #3F6B33 and pale mint #DCE9D2; warm bright soft daylight-balanced studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif used only on blank placeholder plates; thin single-weight line glyphs inside flat rounded pill frames and round discs; seamless studio fields alternating clean white, warm ivory and pale mint plus calm bedroom and laundry frames on warm plaster and oat cabinet walls with pale oak floors; the textile always rendered as a plush quilted channel surface with a piped edge and a fitted side skirt wall; stable product angle and scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no printed wordmarks or hang tags on the textile
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or low skim angle across the tufted surface, consistent textile scale and channel volume across the set, piped edge and skirt wall always readable, nothing covering the seam
style.surfaceSystem: plush quilted channel tufting with a piped edge and a fitted side skirt wall, matte pale-oak floor and pale tile
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one headline plus short pill labels only, always carried on blank placeholder plates
